mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months indicates strong economic demand, which positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) shows a deceleration in annualized growth, this indicates a successful monetary policy in controlling inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with successful inflation control
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL decelerates.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates a robust supply side, which positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs over the past month, it signals strong job growth, which is associated with increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals a weakening economy, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases.
